clips.title: The story
paras: In Kharanos, Magis Sparkmantle trains gnome mages inside the Thunderbrew Distillery. He guides fledgling spellcasters who travel from Coldridge Valley into Dun Morogh.

Dwarves gather at the Thunderbrew Distillery for ale, and Magis Sparkmantle teaches among its casks and kegs. Gnome mages work closely with their dwarven allies across Dun Morogh. Magis helps novice spellcasters deepen their knowledge of the arcane and put it into practice.

Magis teaches beginners their first incantations and points promising students toward wider circles of magic. When they outgrow his early lessons or need specialized guidance, he sends them to other practitioners, including Bink, or to mentors in the Alliance’s main hubs.
